Firmware coalesces 0x1290/0x1294/0x1298 into one 12-byte Modbus read for atomicity (implementation detail, not a protocol structure) — modeled here as three separate protocol registers, matching the upstream reference's own per-register table. The value the UI shows as 'total voltage' is g_total_voltage_v, a non-register calculated field derived from this raw read.

Wire encoding is signed INT32 (S32), confirmed independently by the official PDF (p.11, 'SOCCapRemain' row, distinguished from neighboring UINT32 rows in the same table), the verified V2 workbook, and the upstream project's own comment — batterylifepo4.yaml's value_type was corrected from U_DWORD to S_DWORD to match. A prior pass had instead changed the CANONICAL signedness to unsigned, reasoning that remaining capacity cannot be physically negative; that conflated wire signedness with domain bounds, which are tracked separately here (minimum/maximum stay 0/2000 Ah — the physical range is still non-negative, only the wire's two's-complement interpretation changed).
